matrices.status: Transcribed by hand from a reference image supplied by the user (file Event_risk_classification.png). The publisher of that image is not stated on it. Confirm against the organisation's current official ERC before using any score for a decision.
matrices.question1: If this event had escalated into an accident, what would have been the most probable outcome?
matrices.question2: What was the effectiveness of the remaining barriers between this event and the most probable accident scenario?

rows.definition: Loss of aircraft or multiple fatalities (3 or more)
1 or 2 fatalities, multiple serious injuries, major damage to the aircraft
Minor injuries, minor damage to aircraft
No potential damage or injury could occur

source.title: Event Risk Classification (ERC) — Finding out where the problems really lie

method: ERC (from the ARMS working group) is an analyst judgement: Question 1 = most probable accident outcome; Question 2 = effectiveness of remaining barriers; the score is read from the matrix. Safetytool never computes the two answers.
